brief.claim: Reaction times fall more steeply over practice sessions in healthy subjects than in patients: the mean per-subject linear slope of reaction time on session number is more negative in the healthy group, and a two-sample t test of the difference between the two groups' mean slopes gives two-sided p < 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: median reaction time in milliseconds of each subject in each practice session, sessions in order
whether the subject belongs to the patient group (true) or the healthy group (false)

brief.sizes: subjects = 30; sessions = 8 (rt: 30 x 8 = 240 values; patient: 30 values)
